function ReadInstructions($path){
 @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $path|ForEach-Object{$m=[regex]::Match($_,'^\s*([0-9a-f]+):\s+([a-z][a-z0-9]*)\s*(.*)$');if($m.Success){[pscustomobject]@{Address=[Convert]::ToInt64($m.Groups[1].Value,16);Operation=$m.Groups[2].Value;Operands=($m.Groups[3].Value -replace ' <.*$','');Text=$_}}})
}
$raw=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'native-six-functions.raw.asm')
$bulkLine=$raw|Where-Object{$_ -match '\bcallq\s+(0x[0-9a-f]+).*__BulkMoveWithWriteBarrier'}|Select-Object -First 1
$bulkTarget=[regex]::Match($bulkLine,'\bcallq\s+(0x[0-9a-f]+)').Groups[1].Value
if(!$bulkTarget){'STOP shared copy target';exit 2}
$sets=@()
foreach($role in @('DefaultGeneric','DefaultHand')){
 $all=@(ReadInstructions (Join-Path $evidence ('native-'+$role+'.asm')))
 $firstCopy=-1;$end=-1
 for($i=0;$i -lt $all.Count;$i++){if($firstCopy -lt 0 -and $all[$i].Operation -eq 'callq' -and $all[$i].Operands -eq $bulkTarget){$firstCopy=$i};if($firstCopy -ge 0 -and (($role -eq 'DefaultGeneric' -and $all[$i].Operation -eq 'movl' -and $all[$i].Operands -match '^\$0x1, %eax$') -or ($role -eq 'DefaultHand' -and $all[$i].Operation -eq 'movb' -and $all[$i].Operands -match '^\$0x1, 0x18\(%rbx\)$'))){$end=$i;break}}
 if($firstCopy -lt 0 -or $end -lt 0){'STOP hot bounds '+$role;exit 2}
 $hot=@($all[($firstCopy+1)..($end-1)])
 $index=@{};for($i=0;$i -lt $hot.Count;$i++){$index[$hot[$i].Address]=$i}
 $normalized=@(foreach($ins in $hot){$operands=$ins.Operands;if($ins.Operation -match '^j' -and $operands -match '^0x([0-9a-f]+)$'){$target=[Convert]::ToInt64($Matches[1],16);if($index.ContainsKey($target)){$operands='instruction@'+$index[$target]}else{$operands='external@'+$operands}};$ins.Operation+' '+$operands})
 $branches=@(for($i=0;$i -lt $hot.Count;$i++){if($hot[$i].Operation -match '^j'){$next=if($i+1 -lt $hot.Count){$hot[$i+1].Address}else{$all[$end].Address};$width=$next-$hot[$i].Address;[pscustomobject]@{Instruction=$i;Address=('0x{0:x}' -f $hot[$i].Address);Operation=$hot[$i].Operation;Target=$hot[$i].Operands;Bytes=$width;Mod32=$hot[$i].Address%32;Mod64=$hot[$i].Address%64;Crosses32=([Math]::Floor($hot[$i].Address/32) -ne [Math]::Floor(($next-1)/32));Crosses64=([Math]::Floor($hot[$i].Address/64) -ne [Math]::Floor(($next-1)/64))}})
 $item=[pscustomobject]@{Role=$role;Start=('0x{0:x}' -f $hot[0].Address);EndExclusive=('0x{0:x}' -f $all[$end].Address);Instructions=$hot.Count;Bytes=$all[$end].Address-$hot[0].Address;StartMod32=$hot[0].Address%32;StartMod64=$hot[0].Address%64;Code=$hot;Normalized=$normalized;Branches=$branches}
 $sets+=$item
 'HOT '+($item|Select-Object Role,Start,EndExclusive,Instructions,Bytes,StartMod32,StartMod64|ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
}
$g=$sets[0];$h=$sets[1]
$diff=@(for($i=0;$i -lt [Math]::Max($g.Normalized.Count,$h.Normalized.Count);$i++){if($g.Normalized[$i] -cne $h.Normalized[$i]){[pscustomobject]@{Instruction=$i;Generic=$g.Normalized[$i];Hand=$h.Normalized[$i];GenericText=$g.Code[$i].Text;HandText=$h.Code[$i].Text}}})
'DIFFERENCES '+$diff.Count
foreach($d in $diff){$d|ConvertTo-Json -Compress}
$branchDiff=@(for($i=0;$i -lt [Math]::Min($g.Branches.Count,$h.Branches.Count);$i++){if($g.Branches[$i].Bytes -ne $h.Branches[$i].Bytes){[pscustomobject]@{Instruction=$g.Branches[$i].Instruction;Generic=$g.Branches[$i];Hand=$h.Branches[$i]}}})
'ENCODED_BRANCH_DIFFERENCES '+$branchDiff.Count
$branchDiff|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
$sets|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'default-hot-comparison.json') -Encoding utf8
$diff|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'default-hot-operation-differences.json') -Encoding utf8
$branchDiff|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'default-branch-width-differences.json') -Encoding utf8
foreach($set in $sets){'DEFAULT_HOT '+$set.Role;foreach($line in $set.Code.Text){$line}}
$paths=@(& rg --files src/SomeEngine.ECS|Where-Object{$_ -match '(ComponentRowEnumerator|QueryRow)\.cs$'})
$sourceLines=@(foreach($path in $paths){$path=$path.Replace('\','/');'FILE '+$path;$lines=@(& git show ($source+':'+$path));if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE};for($i=0;$i -lt $lines.Count;$i++){('{0,4}: {1}' -f ($i+1),$lines[$i])}})
$sourceLines|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'default-shared-row-source.txt') -Encoding utf8
'SHARED_ROW_SOURCE'
$sourceLines
$facts=[ordered]@{SourceCommit=$source;NativeReader='c0b4357d7bd14e01b9a3e96f942f8bf2';AnalysisStartedAtUtc=$started.ToString('O');AnalysisFinishedAtUtc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('O');Normalization='Only instruction addresses are removed; internal branch targets use corresponding instruction index. Registers, stack offsets, immediates and external call/branch addresses remain.';GenericHotInstructions=$g.Instructions;HandHotInstructions=$h.Instructions;OperationDifferences=$diff.Count;EncodedBranchDifferences=$branchDiff.Count}
$facts|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $evidence 'default-analysis-facts.json') -Encoding utf8
'AUDIT '+($facts|ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
